name: DesignSuite – Elementor Addons with Widgets & Extensions
author: securesofts

sections.description:
DesignSuite is the artisan’s toolkit for Elementor — a comprehensive collection of modern widgets and extensions designed to elevate your WordPress site building experience.

Live Demo | Documentation | Support

🚀 Why DesignSuite Stands Out:
– Modern Design Language – Every widget follows current design trends
– Lightweight & Fast – Optimized code that won’t slow your site
– Future-Ready Architecture – Built for tomorrow’s features today
– Developer Friendly – Clean, documented, extensible codebase

✨ Core Features:

🎨 Modern Widgets (28+)
– Advanced Post Grid with multiple layouts
– Stylish Testimonials & Team showcases
– Video Popup, Image Gallery, Counters
– Contact Form 7 styler, Social Icons
– And many more professionally designed widgets

🏗️ Theme Builder
– Build custom Headers & Footers
– Create Single Post / Page templates
– Design Archive, Search, and 404 pages
– Use Block templates via shortcode
– Includes dynamic widgets for post content and metadata

⚡ Powerful Extensions
– Custom CSS – Add custom styles directly in Elementor
– Wrapper Link – Transform any container into a clickable link
– Scroll to Top – Elegant, customizable back-to-top button

🔧 For Developers
– Clean, documented codebase
– Action/filter hooks for customization
– Disable unused widgets for performance
– Compatible with major WordPress plugins

🛣️ Roadmap (Coming Soon):
– ✅ GSAP Animations for smooth scroll and reveals
– ✅ Template Library with ready-to-use designs
– ✅ Custom Post Type Builder for advanced users
– ✅ WooCommerce Widgets for online stores
– ✅ Premium Extension Ecosystem with advanced features

🎯 Perfect For:
– Freelancers needing reliable, modern tools
– Agencies building client websites efficiently
– Developers wanting extensible, clean code
– Business Owners creating professional sites quickly

🎨 Complete Widget List

DesignSuite offers a comprehensive collection of Elementor widgets:

  • Heading – Style your headings beautifully
  • Paragraph – Elegant typography options
  • Button – Create visually appealing buttons
  • Image Gallery – Sleek gallery layouts
  • Team – Showcase your team with style
  • Video Popup – Engaging video presentations
  • Contact Form 7 – Style CF7 forms effortlessly
  • Social Icons – One-click social sharing
  • Testimonials Grid – Client feedback showcase
  • Advanced Accordion – Stylish FAQ sections
  • Info Box – Feature highlights with icons
  • Counter – Animated number counters
  • Countdown – Timer for events and offers
  • Site Logo – Display your brand identity
  • Nav Menu – Custom navigation menus

🧩 Dynamic Widgets (Theme Builder)

  • Post Grid – Dynamic content layouts
  • Post Title – Display dynamic post titles
  • Post Excerpt – Show post summaries dynamically
  • Post Content – Render full post content
  • Post Featured Image – Display featured images dynamically
  • Post Comments – Built-in comments and reply support
  • Post Meta – Author, date, categories, and metadata
  • Post Pagination – Previous and next post navigation
  • Social Share – Share current posts easily
  • Archive Title – Dynamic archive titles
  • Simple Search – Add search anywhere
  • Search Query – Current search term display
  • Search No Result – Custom no-results templates

🔧 Extensions

  • Custom CSS – Add custom CSS within Elementor for precise design control
  • Wrapper Link – Transform entire sections into clickable links
  • Scroll To Top – Elegant, customizable back-to-top button with progress indicator

🔒 Brought to you by SecureSofts
DesignSuite is developed with enterprise-grade security and performance standards. Every line of code is crafted for reliability and scalability.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the designsuite folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to DesignSuite → Dashboard to configure widgets and extensions
  4. Edit any page with Elementor to access DesignSuite widgets
  5. Toggle widgets on/off from the dashboard for optimal performance

Manual Installation via FTP:
1. Download the plugin zip file
2. Extract and upload the designsuite folder to /wp-content/plugins/
3. Activate from WordPress admin panel
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro to use DesignSuite?

No! DesignSuite works perfectly with the free version of Elementor. All widgets are fully functional with Elementor free.

Will DesignSuite slow down my website?

No. DesignSuite is lightweight and performance-optimized. You can also disable unused widgets from the Dashboard Control panel to keep your site fast and efficient.

Can I use DesignSuite on client websites?

Absolutely! DesignSuite is GPL licensed – use it on unlimited client websites.

Is DesignSuite translation ready?

Yes! DesignSuite is fully translation-ready and includes .pot files for easy localization.

How do I get support?

Visit the WordPress.org support forum for free support. Premium support will be available with the Pro version.

Will there be a premium version?

Yes! DesignSuite Pro is coming with advanced features:
– GSAP Animations & Scroll Effects
– Template Library
– Custom Post Type Builder
– WooCommerce Widgets
– Priority Support
